limits: Synthetic isolated PG17.4 cluster; selected exact foundation DDL and full seal/lease migrations, not full migration chain or live Supabase.

Actual compiled TypeScript and Supabase JS use a strict injected fetch router: PostgREST-shaped requests execute parameterized real PostgreSQL as service_role; Storage responses are synthetic in-process bytes, not live HTTP/TLS, PostgREST, Storage or RLS acceptance.

Only sine-wave WebM/Opus was used for lease integration. Real FFmpeg is external and not deployment/OS-sandbox qualified. No real-device continuity, output publication, remote migration, paid provider or family data.
